analysis: Jev confidence/error-type overlap with Phase-3 blind construct audit

definitions.confidence: P(predicted operation) × P(predicted target) for predicted UPDATE/DELETE; target factor 1 for ADD/NOOP.
definitions.under_mutation: gold operation is ADD/UPDATE/DELETE and Jev predicts NOOP.
definitions.over_mutation: gold operation is NOOP and Jev predicts ADD/UPDATE/DELETE.
definitions.benchmark_supported_by_both_reviewers: Both reviewers mark policy_applicable=true and independently output the benchmark operation+target (strict_consensus=true).
definitions.reviewer_consensus_mismatch: Neither reviewer marks MATERIAL ambiguity; both output the same operation+target, which differs from benchmark gold (audit category B).
definitions.caution: Reviewer consensus is a construct-validity signal, not adjudicated human gold. NOT_IN_BLIND_AUDIT does not imply mismatch or correctness.
